title: Pine AI Launches Cloud Computer for Agents With Top 78.3% Score
summary:
A new runtime layer for AI agents provides a cloud environment where models can read web pages as structured data rather than simulating human clicks. Pine AI's Pine Computer serves as a specialized operating system that sends live updates directly to models to automate spreadsheet analysis and site navigation without requiring APIs. The system allows human users to intermittently take over for sign-ins or approvals and can execute multiple jobs in parallel, running 2–5x faster than AI on conventional computers.

The product is now available to approved developers via an invite only private beta waitlist. On the SaaS-Bench v1.1, which tests 106 multi-step tasks across 23 business apps, it recorded the highest checkpoint score in the publisher's table at 78.3%, beating the 74.3% scored by Opus 5 with Claude Code. However, it completed fewer whole tasks at 27.4% compared to 31.1% for Opus 5.

selectedTweets.text:
Pine AI launched Pine Computer, a cloud computer, harness, and runtime layer built for agentic tasks.

On SaaS-Bench v1.1, Pine Computer has the highest checkpoint score in the publisher's table: 78.3%, against 74.3% for Opus 5 with Claude Code. It also completed fewer whole tasks: 27.4% against 31.1%. 

The benchmark covers 106 multi-step tasks inside 23 business apps, and the checkpoint score counts the steps passed along the way.

Instead of simulating clicks and screenshots, Pine Computer can read web pages as structured data and report changes directly to the AI.

Access is through a private beta waitlist from @PineAIAssistant
